Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: Breathing difficulty after wasp sting

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Approximately 15 minutes prior to evaluation, the patient was stung by a wasp while gardening.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: HPI: ~15 minutes ago, stung by wasp while gardening.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Following the wasp sting, the patient developed shallow breathing and dyspnea.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Now with shallow breathing and dyspnea.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The patient reports lip tingling after the wasp sting.
The patient reports no throat swelling.
The patient reports chest tightness with no prior similar episodes.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Chest tightness; no prior similar episodes.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Rash and blotching were noted after the wasp sting.

Medications.content: The patient has antihistamines at home used for aerosinusitis.
Medications.source_text: Antihistamines: has some at home (for aerosinusitis)

Social_and_Family_History.content: The patient has a spouse at home.
The patient's wife was asked to call an ambulance.
The patient is aware and agrees to go to the emergency department.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: patient aware and agrees to go to ED

Assessment.content: Acute suspected allergic reaction to wasp sting with airway or bronchospasm risk and anaphylaxis risk given dyspnea and lip tingling; requires urgent emergency department evaluation.
Assessment.source_text: 1) Acute suspected allergic reaction to wasp sting with airway/bronchospasm risk (anaphylaxis risk) given dyspnea and lip tingling; requires urgent ED evaluation.

Assessment.content: Skin reaction with blotching following the wasp sting.
Penicillin allergy and eczema are part of the problem list.

Plan_of_Care.content: Call an ambulance immediately and proceed to the emergency department with transport coordinated by EMS based on the wife’s actions.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Call ambulance now; proceed to ED (transport coordinated by EMS per patient’s wife’s actions).

Plan_of_Care.content: Administer home antihistamine if available by the spouse while awaiting transport.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • In the meantime, administer home antihistamine if available (by spouse) and keep patient calm and monitored.

Plan_of_Care.content: Keep the patient calm and monitored while awaiting transport.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • In the meantime, administer home antihistamine if available (by spouse) and keep patient calm and monitored.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise spouse to watch for signs of airway compromise including throat swelling, stridor, wheeze, dizziness, and confusion, and to escalate immediately if any occur.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Advise spouse to watch for signs of airway compromise: throat swelling, stridor, wheeze, dizziness, confusion; escalate immediately if any occur.

Plan_of_Care.content: Do not delay transport; the patient is to go to the hospital for further evaluation and management.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Do not delay transport; patient to hospital for further evaluation and management.

Follow_up_Information.content: Immediate follow-up is emergency department evaluation via ambulance transport.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: • Call ambulance now; proceed to ED (transport coordinated by EMS per patient’s wife’s actions).
